title.zh: 完整本地化词汇学习界面

purpose.en: Keep every supported site language on the vocabulary route and translate its learning controls, progress, reports, feedback, and metadata instead of falling back to English.
purpose.zh: 让词汇学习路由保留所有支持的网站语言，并翻译学习控件、进度、报告、反馈和元数据，不再回退英文。

en: Allow every supported language on course learning, vocabulary, Sprint, trial, SmartCard, member, payment, legal, Project, sharing, and administration routes.
Add a repository contract that rejects bilingual-only guards regardless of variable name or English/Chinese condition order.
zh: 让课程学习、词汇、速成、试学、智慧卡、会员、付款、法律、Project、分享及管理路由全部支持已提供语言。
增加不受变量名或中英文条件顺序影响的仓库契约，阻止重新引入仅限中英文的页面守卫。

en: All language-prefixed public, learning, member, course, payment, legal, Project, and administration pages
zh: 全部带语言前缀的公开、学习、会员、课程、付款、法律、Project 及管理页面

en: Use the shared static interface catalog for vocabulary titles, controls, hints, speech states, summaries, pagination, and reports.
Add reviewable translations for Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Italian, Portuguese, Arabic, and Hindi.
Preserve SmartLingo vocabulary, pronunciation, sentence-building, progress, and learning-record behavior.
zh: 让词汇页标题、控件、提示、语音状态、总结、分页和报告使用共享静态界面目录。
补齐可审查的日语、韩语、西语、法语、德语、俄语、意语、葡语、阿语和印地语翻译。
保留 SmartLingo 词汇、发音、组句、进度及学习记录行为。

en: Run TypeScript, the route-guard contract, SmartLingo learning contracts, and production build before release.
Deploy, verify the exact Project record, and use real Chrome to open and interact with the Japanese vocabulary deep route.
zh: 发布前执行 TypeScript、路由守卫契约、SmartLingo 学习契约与生产构建。
部署并核验 Project 精确记录，再用真实 Chrome 打开并操作日语词汇深页。

en: Real microphone scoring remains dependent on each learner device; no vocabulary or course records are changed by this routing release.
zh: 真实麦克风评分仍取决于学习者设备；本次路由发布不改变词汇或课程记录。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's twelve target-language courses, five-skill learning model, anonymous trial, SmartCards, Sprint, and reward-point isolation.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 十二目标语言课程、五项技能学习模式、匿名试学、智慧卡、速成及积分隔离。
